source_review.notes: Checked the formal 2026 OMG SysML 2.0 Language, KerML 1.0 and Systems Modeling API and Services 1.0 publications and the current SysML formal artifact page; active NASA-STD-7009B and its public PDF; the current NASA-HDBK-7009B approved 2026-02-03; active NASA-HDBK-1009A; and current NASA Systems Engineering Handbook Product Verification and Product Validation pages. All ten final URLs returned HTTP 200. Claims distinguish language/project consistency, model V&V, and product V&V and do not generalize one evidence layer to another.

evidence: Reviewed controlled model, rule set and four-valued finding notation; confirmed unknown/non-pass status is preserved.
Reviewed intended-use validation acceptance as a conjunction of predeclared metric thresholds over a bounded domain.
Reviewed check-result and validated-domain records for configuration, evidence, uncertainty and expiry fields.
Reviewed MAE and RMSE definitions for residual sign, units and aggregation semantics.
Reviewed release-gate conjunction and confirmed not-applicable and unknown states require explicit policy rather than arithmetic averaging.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The notation structures evidence claims and does not assert that a finite rule set proves model truth or completeness.

evidence: Executed model-consistency-validation-fixture under python3 with exact output recorded in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-057/report.json.

Confirmed eight rule predicates cover usage-name uniqueness, resolved typing, ownership, endpoint resolution, item compatibility, unit compatibility, configuration compatibility and requirement-case coverage.
Confirmed zero rule violations for the declared fixture.
Recomputed absolute validation errors |119-120|, |151-150| and |181-180| as 1, 1 and 1 degrees Celsius, yielding MAE 1.0 degrees Celsius.
Confirmed 1.0 <= the predeclared 2.0 degree teaching threshold and validation_acceptance=1.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Three synthetic points cannot establish statistical power, boundary adequacy, independence, physical validity, requirement compliance or safety.

evidence: Confirmed the finding set retains all non-pass outcomes and does not equate an empty detected-violation set with universal consistency.
Confirmed validation acceptance is bounded to named metrics, thresholds and domain rather than stated as universal model validity.
Confirmed pairwise consistency is not presented as sufficient for global consistency or purpose-relative completeness.
Confirmed MAE and RMSE lose residual sign and require additional bias, boundary, distribution and decision diagnostics.
Confirmed gate conjunction preserves failed or unknown critical gates instead of allowing good scores elsewhere to compensate.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The relations are review structures, not a complete formal logic or statistical validation theorem.

evidence: Challenged parser success, metamodel conformance, project consistency, completeness, implementation correctness, empirical adequacy and acceptance as separate claims.
Reviewed hidden/filtered API scope, incomplete pagination, unknown/error/not-run states, noisy diagnostics, false positives/negatives and expiring suppressions.
Reviewed duplicate names/IDs, unresolved/superseded references, cross-variant evidence, units and interface semantics, derived caches and stale generated views.
Reviewed bounded reachability, scheduling/fairness, deadlock/livelock, solver nonconvergence, tolerance, multiple solutions and numerical instability.
Reviewed conceptual-model error, equation/code/data-pipeline defects, calibration leakage, hindsight threshold selection and shared referent error.
Reviewed average-metric blind spots, signed bias, near-zero relative error, subgroups, boundary/tail/degraded conditions, out-of-distribution use and decision loss.
Reviewed discrepancy investigation, authority/credibility, change triggers, domain shift and invalid reuse of old evidence.
Reviewed all ten examples and five answers for assumptions, intermediate reasoning, evidence limits and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: High-consequence conclusions still require applicable language/metamodel, domain, architecture, numerical, statistics, uncertainty, data, operations, human-factors, safety, security, verification, validation and decision-authority review.

evidence: Traced project, branch/commit, configuration, language/library/profile, tool/rule/query, access and timestamp requirements throughout.
Confirmed syntax, conformance, consistency, completeness, model verification, model validation, product verification, product validation, credibility and acceptance remain distinct.
Confirmed rule lifecycle includes identifier, rationale, predicate, scope, exclusions, severity, diagnostics, ownership, version, fixtures and false-result monitoring.
Confirmed requirement-to-evidence traces maintain compatible subject, baseline, execution and result states.
Confirmed validation fixes intended use, referent, data split, metrics, thresholds and uncertainty before final interpretation.
Confirmed evidence and limitations are preserved and re-opened on material model, data, tool, domain, consequence or discrepancy changes.
invariant_checking.notes: A passed rule or validation gate never silently upgrades another failed, unknown or untested evidence layer.

proof_review.notes: The chapter presents predicates, metrics and evidence invariants but no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Reviewed valid, verified, consistent, complete, conformant, credible, accepted, independent, representative, accurate and adequate language for bounded scope.
The checker output is explicitly synthetic_fixture_only and is repeatedly denied status as SysML conformance or real engineering validation.
NASA modeling-and-simulation guidance is used for lifecycle credibility and intended-use practices, while NASA product V&V guidance is kept at the realized-product layer.
Calibration fit is consistently separated from independent validation evidence, and evidence reuse/dependence must be disclosed.
Passing validation is always qualified by model version, use, domain, referent, metrics, thresholds, uncertainty and limitations.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No external review, product compliance, real-system validation or accreditation is claimed.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked well-formedness, conformance, consistency, completeness, rule/violation, static/dynamic analysis, model verification/validation, product verification/validation, referent, calibration, uncertainty, sensitivity, credibility, acceptance, false positive/negative, unknown, waiver and revalidation. These categories remain distinct throughout the chapter.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked scope/version capture, layered rule families, rule tests/diagnostics, multi-state outcomes, exception control, identity/type/configuration/interface/requirement/behavior/quantity/view checks, conceptual/mathematical/software/numerical verification, intended-use validation, data separation, metrics/domain/sensitivity, discrepancy handling, credibility, automation and change triggers. Cases cover identity, evidence coverage, power units, bounded search, variants, noisy rules, leakage, boundary metrics, partial APIs and solver upgrades.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from the claim ladder through consistency automation, model verification, empirical validation and lifecycle governance. The one-page review supports retrieval; ten examples reveal subtle category errors; five complete solutions require learners to design rules, audit overclaiming, plan risk-sensitive V&V, federate cross-tool checks and govern late toolchain changes.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic, OMG conformance, SysML/KerML language-expert, tool-vendor, domain-model, numerical-methods, statistics, uncertainty, data-quality, operations, human-factors, safety, security, independent V&V, technical-authority, accreditation or decision-authority review is claimed.
